name: Kami no Niwa
source:
Main heroine is archaeologist apprentice who studies hard every day in a walled town where people are exiled by God after attempt to step into the realm of God. Every day brings new incidents. Wind has stopped completely. Temperature has risen. Nights have been getting brighter. No one knows what's happening, but fateful day inevitably comes closer...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人类因试图涉足神的领域而遭神放逐，居住在一座围墙环绕的城镇里。女主角是一名考古学徒，每天都努力学习。新的异变接连发生：风彻底停了，气温不断升高，夜晚也越来越明亮。无人知晓究竟发生了什么，但命运注定的那一天，正不可避免地步步逼近…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
